name: Vritra Slayer
body:
Prerequisite(s): 3rd level stormbound

Benefit(s): The vajrin is especially skilled at fighting vritra and creatures that share its nature. The vajrin gains a +2 insight bonus on Bluff, Knowledge, Perception, Sense Motive, and Survival checks against creatures with the dragon type or the akashic or aquatic subtypes. They also get a +1 insight bonus on weapon attack and damage rolls against such creatures. At 5th level and every 5 stormbound levels thereafter this insight bonus increases by+1.
